changes.comment: sdk-ui-ext: `InsightView` applies the stored parameter overrides of the insight. A value in `execConfig.parameterValues` wins over the stored override of the same parameter. A stored override is not sent when its parameter does not exist or when the value is not valid for its parameter.
sdk-backend-spi: Add the `loadParameters` option to `IGetInsightOptions`. With it, `getInsight` returns the parameters that the insight references in `referencedParameters` of the insight.
